hardQuoteObservations.preregisteredQuote: Business Reception & Dining Weekdays Only Full Course with 3 Wine Pairings and Souvenir + Weekday Dinner

Introducing our exclusive weekday special plan, perfect for important business dinners and entertaining clients, limited to just three groups per day. We offer a unique space welcoming only a select few guests, featuring exquisite French cuisine and carefully paired wines. Chef Watanabe's expertise: Drawing from the lineage of the renowned Alain Chapel, he has honed his skills in Michelin-starred restaurants in France, delivering authentic classic French dishes. Enjoy a supreme full course that includes our signature "Sautéed Foie Gras." Madame Watanabe's pairings: With certification from Robert Parker, Madame Watanabe will suggest exquisite wine pairings perfectly matched to each dish, ensuring that your conversations flow without interruption from drink orders. *Includes a special gift from the chef.
Lunch Luxurious Course with Shrimp, Seafood, and Wagyu Fillet as Two Main Dishes

We have prepared a special plan for entertaining important guests or hosting business meals in a calm atmosphere. Enjoy a delightful and delicious experience. *The ambiance of our restaurant resembles a chic, small French bistro. ★ Highly recommended for seniors!
